claims.claim: The exit of wide-body damp-lease operations will be accretive to spreads.
claims.quote: On the wide-body removal, we expect it to be accretive to spreads.

claims.claim: Load factors in the third quarter will be flat year-on-year.
claims.quote: we think load factors in the third quarter, and remember, it is seasonally stronger, will be flat during the quarter based on our current position and forward bookings

claims.claim: There is a direct correlation between fuel price and ticket prices.
claims.quote: As fuel prices go up, ticket prices go up; as fuel prices come down, ticket prices come down. Not exactly in line, but there is a correlation there

claims.claim: Passenger demand held up despite a volatile environment, with 31.3 million passengers served.
claims.quote: Despite a volatile environment, passenger demand held up as we served 31.3 million passengers, a growth of ~1% year over year.

claims.claim: The quarter was marked by a constructive pricing environment and the ability to pass through cost pressures.
claims.quote: The quarter was marked by constructive pricing environment, and our ability to pass through a part of the elevated fuel and operating-cost pressure in a disciplined manner.

claims.claim: Fuel and currency were the biggest drags on economic performance during the quarter.
claims.quote: But as you're well aware, the kind of environment that we are in right now, the fuel and the currency have been the biggest drag.

claims.claim: Demand is inelastic to fare hikes for the moment.
claims.quote: For the moment, what we are seeing is as we take the fares up, the market is inelastic to these hikes in fares.

claims.claim: IndiGo consistently led in on-time performance across the last quarter.
claims.quote: This is evident in outcomes, with us consistently leading in on‑time performance across the last quarter

claims.claim: Domestic fuel cost increases were largely passed through due to government and oil company support.
claims.quote: On the domestic side, we have managed to recover to a large part, the increased cost that is there

claims.claim: IndiGo was the largest recipient of Airbus aircraft globally for the second consecutive year.
claims.quote: An important milestone is our position as the largest recipient of Airbus aircraft globally for the second consecutive year, accounting for around 7% of all Airbus deliveries worldwide.

claims.claim: October and November witnessed healthy loads driven by festive season.
claims.quote: In terms of passenger revenue, the quarter started on a strong note with October & November witnessing healthy loads driven by festive season.

claims.claim: The company has processed timely refunds for all impacted customers from the December operational disruptions.
claims.quote: We have processed timely refunds of all of the impacted customers and, further, as a gesture of care, we have also extended travel vouchers to lakhs of severely impacted and stranded customers

claims.claim: Reported a profit of 1 billion rupees excluding foreign exchange and hedging impact.
claims.quote: we reported a profit of 1 billion rupees or 104 crore rupees against a loss of INR 7.5 billion rupees, during the same period last year.

claims.claim: Passenger numbers grew 4% YoY while the overall industry remained stagnant.
claims.quote: The number of passengers served by us during the quarter grew by around 4 percent on a year- over-year basis whereas the overall industry remained largely stagnant.

claims.claim: Net foreign exchange exposure is approximately 9 billion dollars.
claims.quote: the net exposure as of the end of September is approximately 9 billion dollars.

claims.claim: IndiGo served more than 31 million customers, reflecting a solid growth of 12 percent compared to the same period last year.
claims.quote: we served more than 31 million customers, reflecting a solid growth of 12 percent compared to the same period last year.

claims.claim: Profit after tax of 21.8 billion rupees with a profit after tax margin of around 11 percent.
claims.quote: we reported a profit after tax of 21.8 billion rupees, or almost 2,200 crore rupees with a profit after tax margin of around 11 percent.

claims.claim: Fuel CASK reduced by 21.9 percent on a year over year basis.
claims.quote: the fuel CASK reduced by 21.9 percent on a year over year basis driven by a reduction in average fuel prices, contract negotiation and redeliveries of older generation aircraft.

synthesis.one_liner: IndiGo shows accelerating revenue growth and expanding operating margins, but profitability remains volatile and leverage is high.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management highlights strong demand and constructive pricing allowing cost pass-through.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management guided for early single-digit capacity growth for the full financial year 2027.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Full year capacity guidance was cut from 1–9% down to 1–3% between calls.
